title: Kotodama Runtime
summary: The toolchain in SORA Nexus that validates Kotodama contracts before deployment, ensuring pointer ABIs and gas tables are compatible with the current network version.
definition: The toolchain in SORA Nexus that validates Kotodama contracts before deployment, ensuring pointer ABIs and gas tables are compatible with the current network version.
tagline: Catches incompatible or malformed contracts before deployment, preventing costly on-chain failures and ensuring all deployed code meets network standards.
